messages.subject: no applicable method for 'meta' applied to an object of class "try-error"
parts:
Hi,

My app runs prefectly fine in my local browser, but when i try to run it from the server it shows the following error : no applicable method for 'meta' applied to an object of class "try-error"

I have already googled various solutions for it and accordingly tried to change the code . But nothing works for me.

I tried to make changes as given in the below links
1)http://stackoverflow.com/questions/26834576/big-text-corpus-breaks-tm-map

2)http://stackoverflow.com/questions/25069798/r-tm-in-mclapplycontentx-fun-all-scheduled-cores-encountered-errors

I am also pasting my server.R file here...please have a look


library(twitteR)

token_secret<-"1gbbNnfIhxS9laLHLM9dr8TAypW6OmzZT87PJCuLmtvYg"
setup_twitter_oauth(api_key, api_secret, token, token_secret)



shinyServer(function(input, output) {

output$plot1<- renderPlot({

    input$goButton
    isolate(
             tweets <- userTimeline(input$firstname, n = 3200)
              )
    
    tweets.df <- twListToDF(tweets)
    myCorpus <- Corpus(VectorSource(tweets.df$text)) 
    myCorpus <- tm_map(myCorpus, content_transformer(function(x) iconv(x, to='utf8', sub='byte')), mc.cores=1)
    myCorpus <- tm_map(myCorpus, content_transformer(tolower),lazy=TRUE,mc.cores=1)
    myCorpus <- tm_map(myCorpus, removePunctuation,lazy=TRUE,mc.cores=1)
    myCorpus <- tm_map(myCorpus, removeNumbers,lazy=TRUE,mc.cores=1)

    
    removeURL <- function(x) gsub("http[[:alnum:]]*", "", x)

    myCorpus <- tm_map(myCorpus, removeURL,lazy=TRUE,mc.cores=1)
    myStopwords <- c(stopwords("english"), "available", "via")
    myStopwords <- setdiff(myStopwords, c("r", "big"))
    myCorpus <- tm_map(myCorpus, removeWords, myStopwords,lazy=TRUE,mc.cores=1)
    myCorpusCopy <- myCorpus
    myCorpus <- tm_map(myCorpus, stemDocument,lazy=TRUE,mc.cores=1)

    myCorpus <- tm_map(myCorpus, stemCompletion,dictionary = myCorpusCopy,lazy=TRUE,mc.cores=1)

    tdm <- TermDocumentMatrix(myCorpus, control = list(wordLengths = c(1, Inf)))
   
    idx <- which(dimnames(tdm)$Terms == "r") (freq.terms <- findFreqTerms(tdm, lowfreq = 15))

    term.freq <- rowSums(as.matrix(tdm))
    term.freq <- subset(term.freq, term.freq >= 15)
    df <- data.frame(term = names(term.freq), freq = term.freq)
    print(ggplot(df, aes(x = term, y = freq)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
            xlab("Terms") + ylab("Count") + coord_flip())

})
